answer: Run an admission auction for the island economy: only 100 slots open each season, and every agent must bid to enter. Winning bids lock into a shared vault as a deposit, so each clone must outbid an honest agent. At 25 POA per slot, 1,000 fake identities cost 25,000 POA locked away versus 5 POA per fake seat, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and get the deposit back after a clean season; each genuine bid carries a sable seal.
